name: Coupon code badge
oneLiner: an enamel discount badge in the brand colour spins in and lands while its number counts up, a perforated glass ticket slides out from behind it, the code types in under a caret, a dashed frame snaps round it and the copy button turns green: Copied
say: on a sponsor read or an offer ('use code SAVE30 for 30% off your first three months'): cut in on the discount, the code types as they spell it, the copy press lands on the end of the line; amount can be $20 or 2 months, detail what the deal covers
